fichas.title: What Counts as Living Area
fichas.summary: The housing-area regulation defines living area by rooms belonging exclusively to the dwelling or intended for occupants’ sole use. The excerpt lists included and excluded spaces, including conditions for enclosed conservatories, pools, balconies, loggias and terraces.
spaces: Rooms belonging exclusively to the dwelling
uses: Determine which rooms and ancillary spaces count as living area
figure_refs: 2: Rooms included in living area (housing area regulation, excerpt)

fichas.title: Room Floor-Area Measurement and Inclusion
fichas.summary: Room floor area is determined from the clear space between building components, measured from the face of cladding in the completed room or from a suitable construction drawing. The regulation excerpt lists inclusions and exclusions and gives rules for counting areas according to clear height and type of space.
uses: Determine the portion of floor area included in living area

dimensions.label: Clear height for full inclusion
dimensions.context: Rooms and parts of rooms with a clear height of at least this amount count completely.
dimensions.ocr_raw: rooms and parts of rooms with a clear height of at least 2 m

dimensions.label: Clear height lower threshold for half inclusion
dimensions.context: Rooms and parts of rooms with a clear height of at least this amount and less than 2 m count as half; the excerpt also names unheated, fully enclosed conservatories and swimming pools.
dimensions.ocr_raw: rooms and parts of rooms with a clear height of at least 1 m and less than 2 m, unheated and fully enclosed conservatories, swimming pools etc.

dimensions.label: Pillar height threshold for exclusion
dimensions.context: Pillars are excluded when they meet the listed height and floor-area criteria.
dimensions.ocr_raw: pillars (from 1.5 m height and 0.1 m² floor area)

dimensions.label: Pillar floor-area threshold for exclusion
dimensions.context: Pillars are excluded when they meet the listed height and floor-area criteria.
dimensions.ocr_raw: pillars (from 1.5 m height and 0.1 m² floor area)

dimensions.label: Stair threshold for exclusion
dimensions.context: Stairs and landings from this number of steps are excluded.

dimensions.label: Niche depth threshold for exclusion
dimensions.context: Door, window and wall niches are excluded if they do not reach the floor or are at least this deep.
dimensions.ocr_raw: door niches, window and wall niches (which do not reach to the floor or are at least 0.13 m deep)

fichas.title: KfW Subsidy Bank Programmes
fichas.summary: Describes the KfW Subsidy Bank as a public body providing favourable loans through targeted programmes for owner-occupied housing, ecological building, housing modernisation, energy refurbishment, and solar electricity production.
uses: Finance construction or purchase of owner-occupied housing
Support passive houses and energy-saving houses
Reduce energy use in existing buildings
